summary: Butte County lookout staffed from 1927; 1934 station, 1930s CCC cab replaced by a CDF cab in 1972; NHLR-registered 2004; access and current staffing unclear.

facts.design: 30-foot battered open steel tower with a 196 sq ft wood-frame cab; the 1930s CCC-built cab was replaced with a CDF design in 1972

staffing.status: listed as possibly staffed in June 2008 fire season; no later staffing source found

events.note: Charles Leyval employed by the Forest Service as lookout man at Sun-Set Hill
Feather River Bulletin reports on a new lookout station on Sunset Hill; gives tower as 50 feet (NHLR gives 30 feet)
Robert Owens stationed at the tower after Mrs. Halloran, wife of the lookout, was injured
Alice M. Marvin, who started on Lexington Hill in 1942, transferred to Sunset Hill in spring 1943
Sunrise Easter service held near the lookout station; about 250 attended
NHLR: 1930s CCC-built cab replaced with a CDF cab design
Named on CAL FIRE June 2008 list of lookouts that may be staffed in the fire season

corrections.proposed: 1972 modified (CDF cab replaced a 1930s CCC cab); 1934 replaced (new lookout station), with a Forest Service lookout man already posted in 1927
corrections.why: NHLR's Built field says 1972, but its description says the 1972 work replaced the 1930s CCC-built cab on an existing 30-foot tower, so the event is a modification; newspapers show a lookout man on the hill in 1927 and a new station in 1934.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives a 30-foot steel tower under the cab; the 1934 Feather River Bulletin item gives the new station's tower as 50 feet with living quarters at the top. The sources do not reconcile these, so the NHLR figure (9.1 m) is used.

notes_for_editor: Brief's 1972 build date corrected (see corrections). Height conflict left open: 30 ft (NHLR) vs 50 ft (1934 newspaper). No public-access or visiting source found, so access and visit keys are omitted. Staffing evidence ends at the June 2008 CAL FIRE list. Brief's agency wording matches the weebly header.
